notes: Evidence Validation Layer contract · founder-authorised 2026-09-12 as pre-Phase-5 correction C-2. Sits between every Evidence Specialist and NEX2 consumption. Rejects raw specialist claims. Produces AuthoritativeEvidenceRecord only when all seven checks pass. Deterministic. Advisory. Read-only.
constitutional_purpose_locked_2026_09_12: Ensure that no specialist observation reaches NEX2 or NEX3 unless every provenance, reproducibility, hash, scope, staleness, and authorisation check has been enforced. Raw specialist claim ≠ authoritative evidence.

seven_checks.purpose: Input record conforms to a declared schema_version · required fields are present · types match
tool + tool_version + methodology fields are non-empty
deterministic=true AND external_llm_used=false AND reproducibility_information carries command + cwd + env_fingerprint + node_version + platform + seed
source_hash / input_hash / methodology_hash present · byte_identity_witness present · determinism_witness present
record explicitly declares what its evidence covers (paths · versions · rulesets) and what it does NOT
recorded_at is present · source_hash matches current computed hash of the referenced sources OR record explicitly declares state=STALE
authorisation === false AND execution === false constants · authority_boundary present · no self-promotion field

input_shape_contract.note: Any specialist record (DebuggerEvidence · SecurityEvidence · ArchitectureEvidence · TestEvidence · PerformanceObservation · RefactorCandidate · DependencyObservation · UIQAObservation · DocDrift · ReleasePreflight · RequirementsContract) is a valid input provided it declares record_type, schema_version, produced_by, attribution, authorisation, execution, and the field families above.

output_record_fields.name: check_results
output_record_fields.shape: array of { check_id · result: pass|fail · detail }

output_record_fields.name: cited_input_hashes
output_record_fields.shape: array of sha256 prefixes reused from the source record

invariants: REJECTED verdicts are FIRST-CLASS SUCCESSFUL OUTCOMES · the validator's job is to reject broken evidence · a REJECTED record is more valuable than a fabricated VALIDATED one
Validator MUST NOT modify the input record · it produces a NEW AuthoritativeEvidenceRecord
Validator MUST NOT accept a record whose attribution.external_llm_used !== false
Validator MUST NOT accept a record whose attribution.deterministic !== true
Validator MUST NOT accept a record whose authorisation !== false or execution !== false
Validator MUST NOT accept a record whose authority field claims 'authoritative' or 'promotion' or 'execution' or 'authority'
Validator MUST NOT infer missing fields · missing = REJECTED
Validator MUST NOT synthesize a numerical validation score · check_results carry pass/fail ordinal only
external_llm_used MUST be false for the validator itself
chain_integrity_hash MUST be deterministic re-run of the check sequence
authorisation_state check enforces the constitutional constant · a record where 'authorisation' or 'execution' can be modified at runtime MUST be REJECTED
downstream_consumers: Evidence Engine · consumes AuthoritativeEvidenceRecord · never raw specialist output
